result.title: LeanDojo-v2: A Comprehensive Library for AI-Assisted Theorem Proving in Lean
result.comment: 11 pages, 7 figures, accepted to NeurIPS Math-AI workshop
result.summary: Building on recent progress in machine learning for formal theorem proving in Lean, we introduce LeanDojo-v2: an end-to-end framework that unifies repository data extraction, LLM fine-tuning, proof search, AI autocompletion, and LLM-assisted theorem proving in a single software library. In addition, we provide Lean4Code, a lightweight IDE that integrates the various features of LeanDojo-v2 through a simple, mathematician-friendly UI. These tools will enable mathematicians and researchers to easily fine-tune language models on domain-specific Lean codebases and experiment with LLM-assisted theorem proving without a complex setup.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 LeanDojo-v2，一个把 Lean 仓库数据抽取、LLM 微调、证明搜索、AI 自动补全与人机协作证明整合到同一软件库的端到端框架，并提供配套的 Lean4Code 轻量 IDE。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作以 Lean 编译器验证驱动搜索与补全的流程，可能为 LVR 中外部证据核验、停止决策及轨迹式监督的工程化组织提供思路参考，但不涉及视觉输入或 latent 推理状态，联系较远，可供核查。
